temporal_observation.closure_phase_readout_semantics: Integer native cuts are not seconds. The initial admitted closure anchors a lineage and is excluded from later-return counting. A reclosure is not an oscillator cycle, shed packet or detector timestamp. Fixed gains supply declared cycle equivalents per reclosure; they are not derived atomic laws.
temporal_observation.correction_ownership: Source quantity/observation retains correction owner, inclusion/application status and residual uncertainty. Already-included NP3/wall terms remain included; passive assessment and quantity dispatcher apply no corrections.
temporal_observation.physical_correspondence_scope: No universal seconds per bip, atomic frequency, lifetime, nuclear kernel, prepared isotope assignment or shared atomic retention/hyperfine law supplied by these interfaces. Downstream construction and readout laws must be explicitly bound and replayed.
temporal_observation.realization_and_si_map: Exact defining frequency9192631770Hz is separate from a realized Cs clock. Conditional elapsed interval is reference cycle equivalents divided by that integer; mean rate is compared cycle equivalents divided by elapsed interval. Coordinate/epoch and positive gains are frozen. Derived reciprocal period is not the elapsed interval.
temporal_observation.reference_lineage_semantics: Compared and reference are distinct admitted Wave histories with identity/scope/lineage and directed Contact witnesses. Duplicate references or shared calibration payloads are dependent evidence; absence of collision does not prove independence.
temporal_observation.shared_calibration_dependence: Prediction plan lists the actual calibration dependency closure. Duplicate source/quantity aliases and aggregate/component double counting reject. Supplied joint covariance is retained; calibration equality is not independent validation.
temporal_observation.window_and_population_semantics: Counts use(lo,hi]; original context preserves actual population/preparation, complete operative directed contacts, committed prefixes, pending payloads, and previous comparison for nonzero prior lag. Selected windows are contained in the admitted envelope and do not certify future response.
